## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at Criterion Building 225-229 Piccadilly.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> London gave the world the likes of Queen, Led Zeppelin, and the Rolling Stones. What better place to celebrate this musical heritage than Piccadilly Circus' world-famous Hard Rock Cafe?
>
> While you're surrounded by priceless British and international rock 'n roll memorabilia, bite into the Original Legendary® Burger – a taste of America that comes with a Black Angus steak burger, smoked bacon, cheddar cheese, leaf lettuce, vine-ripened tomato, and a crispy onion ring. A crisp, refreshing soft drink is included too!

## Where this page comes from
